noCodes: Duke publishes no building-code list for class schedules: the registrar's class-scheduling, 25Live classroom-management and reserve-classroom pages (registrar.duke.edu) list none, and Duke Finance's Building_Codes PDFs (resources.finance.duke.edu/accounting/yearend) are accounting numbers, not schedule codes (checked 2026-11-07).
